events.context: No earthquake on 1-2 May 1945 appears in the USGS/ISC-GEM or ISC bulletins (searched within 1,500 km). Those catalogues are only reliable for magnitude 6+ quakes in 1945, and Taiwan's own seismograph network nearly stopped recording from March 1945 to January 1946, so a moderate quake off eastern Taiwan could easily go unrecorded. The nearest catalogued events are an M6.1 west of Yonaguni on 10 April 1945 and an M6.5 off Hualien on 1 August 1945.
